gate: Lee et al. 2014 SRP040309 SRA experiment/sample metadata mapping
permitted_operations: query NCBI SRA metadata XML for the already frozen SRP040309 study records
record experiment title/design/library metadata and sample title/description/attributes
forbidden_operations: compute differential expression or recovery outcomes
select samples based on observed molecular outcomes
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio, or Bio Chi
pass_rule: public SRA metadata explicitly supplies enough sample/experiment labels to map the study design without reading sequence or expression values
stop_rule: if mapping requires inferring biological states not explicitly identified by source metadata/publication, preserve ambiguity rather than inventing labels
